mobwalk.config.generic.comment.enabled: Show the standable-surface overlay when holding a stick.
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.mobProfil: Which mob size the walkable area is calculated for (Point, Player, or Ravager).
mobwalk.config.generic.comment.floodRadi: How far the selection spreads from the clicked block. Large values may slow the game.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchSeeTh: While crouching, show selected surfaces through walls.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchScrol: While crouching with a stick, scroll to change flood radius instead of the hotbar.
mobwalk.config.debug.comment.crouchCycle: While crouching with a stick, right-click air to cycle the mob profile.
